purpose: Directly accept or reject same-current-surface spatial propagation as the missing moving-flash coverage mechanism.
invariant: Benchmark architecture 9 only; production architecture 0 remained unchanged and no neighbor RGB or display history was transported.
primary_gate: moving clear-to-5% <=70 ms; moving-flash reduction >=0.45; perceptual minimum reduction >=0.70; WCAG SC 2.3.1 and 2.3.2 pass
interpretation: Mode 9 was numerically identical to mode 8 on every reported gate metric. The neighbor-event propagation path therefore added no useful moving-flash authority and is rejected rather than threshold-tuned. Together with Matrix 16, this shifts the next architectural attempt toward a short nonrecursive temporal phase hold rather than broader same-frame spatial propagation.
